summary: Tested MyJobsTab (backend + frontend) for the Jobs Board poster dashboard. All 6 backend regression tests pass and all UI flows work: deep-link, list rendering, count badge, expand, applicant enrichment (name/quote/message), close→closed pill, reopen→open pill, view public page, empty state, tab visibility for renter AND owner.

issues: Applicant display_name falls back to literal 'Provider' when the applying user has no marketplace_providers row (e.g. owner@test.com). Not a MyJobsTab bug — it's a data-enrichment fallback in GET /jobs/{id}/applications — but for a poster this looks unhelpful. Consider falling back to the user's full_name from db.users when marketplace_providers is missing.

action_items: (Optional polish) In /api/marketplace/jobs/{id}/applications, when marketplace_providers has no row for the applicant, fall back to users.full_name instead of the literal 'Provider' string so posters see real names.
critical_code_review_comments: applications are lazy-loaded on expand (only when count > 0) — good perf.
onStatusChange updates local state but does NOT refresh applications_count. Not a bug for close/reopen (count doesn't change) but worth noting for future award/delete flows.
DashboardTabs: tab-my-jobs is correctly ungated (visible to all roles) per spec. Verified in UI for renter and owner.

PostJob toast action button 'My jobs' (sonner) not directly tested via UI (would risk hitting the auth rate limiter with a third login) — covered indirectly since navigation to /dashboard?tab=my-jobs works via deep-link.
test_credentials: renter@test.com / Test1234!, owner@test.com / Test1234! — both work
seed_data_creation: Backend tests self-clean via fixture teardown. UI tests seeded a TEST_ job + owner application via API, then deleted the job at the end. No residual data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: MyJobsTab is fully working. Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_my_jobs.py. Run via `pytest backend/tests/test_my_jobs.py -v`. Applicant display_name enrichment falls back to 'Provider' string when applicant has no marketplace_providers row — minor UX nit only.
